credit: The cloud settled on the sanctuary and the glory filled it, and Moses could not go in — find the word for the light that kept him out.
card: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle. And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of meeting, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle.
